column1: # 月姫 1.0.2 main (NSO through research/tools/ghidra/nso2elf.py; Ghidra loads it
# at 0x100000; the fan patch's main is the same but 65 bytes): functions and
# data identified so far, applied by ghidra_export.sh --names. Columns

column3: Runs one script command: switch on its first letter, then the next three packed as an int (0x504c59 = "PLY" for _MPLY)
_MPLY(n,...): reads the backquote options, plays music n through FUN_0019c470 (fade-in from option 001), sets heard-music flag bit n+0xC80 for n < 0x418
Parses the current argument as a short (guess)
Music number n to the sound library's item ID: table of 132 u32 at 0x433F90 (0, then 0x01000000+n-1)
Plays music n (sound n-1 of knife1.bfsar) with volume and start offset
Splits a command's arguments: up to 20 (start, end) pairs
True if argument i is present and not empty
Evaluates argument i as an expression
Finds a picture name in the table of 23,000 names at 0x6E02A4 (records of 0x48 bytes at 0x56F830)
_STCH: set a picture on a layer (args in docs/games/tsukihime.md, "The exe")
_STCC(n): clear layer n (none: 0; negative: all 40)
_STCP(layer, p): set the layer's priority
_STZ4(layer, x0, y0, x1, y1, ms, e, f): zoom in per mille over ms
_STMA(layer, m, mode, p): start motion m from the exe's tables
Field f of motion keyframe k (0x40-byte records at 0x75CE18, 71,905)
_FADS(type, ms, rule, mode): show the staged layers (0 fade, 2 rule mask)
Loads rule mask n: the n+1-th entry after mask_top.mzp
_WNTY(n): text window type
_STEC: fill colour (strtol) and effects 2-82 (findings row _STEC)
motion key easing 0x04 (Penner set, 0/1 straight), from the last key before (findings row motion)
_STZ4 timed zoom
_STZ4 byte f (0x874): zoom off the picture's size
_CLO3: fade out in 4 frames; nothing if the window isn't up
_WNTY type 0/1: line offset 3.5 or 5.5
_FADS ms: frames or ms
_STBR: shader n
_STRT: turn 1/100 deg to `to` from `from` over ms*60/1000 frames; cx, cy
_STGS: from default the layer's alpha, to default 0, over 254 -> 255; ms*60/1000 frames
_MFAD: option 1 fade, 11 a second fade
_SEPL: plays on its channel in place of the one there; the same loop there at volume > 0 goes on
_SEFD: channel (< 0 all), option 1 fade ms
next text fades the window in over 18 frames when hidden (_ZM/_MSAD)
rand() only under FUN_0013c970 (an effect), not a script command
rand() only under FUN_0013c970 (an effect), not a script command
_STCH: 12-16 clip rectangle and frame, 17 frame colour
_RDST: read flag n (0..0x23F)
_STMA argument 3 (p): start time of the motion
motion key easing 0x04 (Penner set, 0/1 straight), from the last key before (with FUN_00130c80)
motion 0x06 mode 1: a cubic curve
motion: -32767 unchanged, -32766 no key (interpolated)
motion field mask u64 at 0x46AB38+8m (x 0x40880, y 0x5100000, alpha 0x4000, zoom 0x80200000/0x100400000, turn 0x88000)
motion 9999: the whole time eased by key 0's easing
motion field mask u64 at 0x46AB38+8m (with FUN_00197b80)
motion loop start (1: from the start; else ms); jump table
keys of motion m: [end(m-1), end(m)), length = last key's time (with FUN_00199fc0)
keys of motion m: [end(m-1), end(m)), length = last key's time
a one-shot cut by the next sound on its channel (_SEPL)
clock: nn::time in FUN_001f67xx (save dates)
_FADE(type, ms, …): screen filter switch by type 0-41; 40 sets filter mode 4 (state 0x898) with level 127+arg1 and arg2, 41 clears it
_FCLN: argument 5 starts full-screen effect n (screen_effect_set); arguments 0-4 never read
_FCSP(ms): ends the full-screen effect over ms*60/1000 frames
full-screen effect n (4-33 from the table at 0x45261c) at once, or 0: fade it out over the frames given
_MSQK(ms, a, b): text window shake; ms over 10000 -> 1000, a*640/1280, b*448/720
_MVOL: music volume to option 17 over option 1 ms
true if global read flag n (words 300+ of the global save) is set; n < 0x240
_RDAS: with setting 0x5e on and global read flag n set, sets DAT 06b0 = 1 (read-skip, inferred)
_RDED(n): n the scene _RTST started and its per-play bit set -> global read flag n; returns 0 then
_RTST(n): per-play bit n (state words 0xc9+); current scene +0xdc = n
(1): false when the completion bits (global 0x29c) are all set; (else): flags 0x1e6-0x231 all set
returns DAT_00c34af0 (set by FUN_00148ac0); _IFSC jumps when 0
_RTM_: stops the 20 sound channels, the music unless DAT_0156e64d (_RTM2/_RTMN)
_SEVL: channel n%20 volume to option 17 over option 1 ms (0: 2000 ms)
_SGMA(layer, m, k): writes the layer's live x, y, alpha, picture into key k of motion m
_SQK2: layer quake (layer_quake_start kind 1); x, y amplitude default 15, ms argument 4 *3/50
_SHK2: layer_quake_start kind 2
_SSW2: layer_quake_start kind 3
starts per-layer effect kind 1-3 (_SQK2/_SHK2/_SSW2) on a layer
_SQS2/_SHS2/_SSS2: clears effect kind 1/2/3 on a layer (< 0: all 40)
_SHOK: screen shake FUN_0012ee70(1, a0, a1, a2 = 300, a3 = 3, a4 = 0); not while skipping
_SHAF(): ends the screen shake at once
_SHAF(ms): the screen shake decays over ms*60/1000 frames
_SNX2(layer, v): layer floats 0x1454 / live +0x248 = v/255+1
_SNX3(layer, v): layer floats 0x1458 / live +0x24c = v*0.01+1
_SPMA(b): byte +8 of every layer's motion state = (b == 1)
_STCF(layer, mask = 63): wait flag 0x20 until layer_busy is false for the mask
a layer's timed changes still running, by mask bit (1-8 counters +0x78/+0x7e/+0x84/+0x8a, 16 +0x13c, 32 motion)
frame loop: clears the wait flags (4 voice, 0x20 _STCF) when their condition ends
_STCG(name): sets the picture's CG flag (bitset at 07a8, < 0xc80)
_STCL(?, layer, x0, y0, x1, y1, ms, ease): stops the motion, moves the layer
_STNS(layer, n 0-12): layer +0x1b0 = n, +0x1b1 = 1 if n > 2 else 3
_STPV(layer, x, y): the live +0x64/+0x68 pair the motion keys 0x0E/0x10 drive
_STRA(layer, v, ms): layer +0x238 to v over ms*60/1000 frames
_STRR(layer, angle): 0xbe4 = angle in 1/100 deg (-99999 -> -0x8000)
_TOMP(n): overlay_open slot 0 kind 0 with n
opens overlay slot s of kind k (table 0x673730, 0x88 bytes a kind)
sets overlay slot s's flag (+0x28 of its record); _XRSM, _FADE
the voice channel's state (0: not playing)
_SELA: choice screen mode 3 (two slots) when state +0x8bc is 0
_SELS: choice screen mode 2 (two slots)
_SELD argument 1 (choice 1-0x52): sets its global flags (table 0x4594d0, words 400+)
_ATSV: copies the 0x3aa8-byte save record into the auto-save buffer
first change after a text: copies the scene state (0x19b8 bytes) for the save
